title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Master cassette -> metal cassette x 2 -> CD-R (Sony TC-K717ES -> Marantz CDR500) -> Audacity -> AIFF -> FLAC Pitch adjusted - 1% to match patch source
source: FOB audience recording, taper and equipment unknown

ai_review.summary: Excellent outdoor audience recording captures a high‑energy show with standout performances of Loser, Ship of Fools, Crazy Fingers and the seamless Not Fade Away → The Other One → Wharf Rat suite.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers an inspiring live experience – the second set flows like a psychedelic journey, highlighted by a soulful Ship of Fools, a historic Crazy Fingers, and Jerry’s guitar soaring through the Not Fade Away into The Other One transition.  Although it’s an audience capture, listeners praise its clarity and lack of indoor echo, making the performance both listenable and emotionally powerful.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high‑rated reviews (mostly 5 stars) praise both the musical performance and the audience recording quality; weighting favors the exceptional show with a good‑to‑excellent source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Outdoor audience capture noted as very clear with no room echo; reviewers describe it as a very good audience recording despite the absence of soundboard tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set capped by Loser, followed by a second‑set that blends spacey improvisation into Not Fade Away → The Other One → Wharf Rat, creating an epic psychedelic flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for speaking with his guitar; licks in the NFA→Other One suite called genius and a highlight of the night.
